description: This is my first time participating in the Nasa Space Apps Challenge. Looking forward to doing my best and learning throughout this challenge.
summary: I developed a game for people to see what an expedition to Mars would look like. It follows Jane, the captain of a 5-member journey to Mars and all kinds of challenges he faces there. The game is a 2d visual-novel style game where your choices can lead to different endings. While this game is meant to be targeted towards kids, anyone who plays it should be able to learn something from it.
